svg.title: Pass rate by task tag
svg.desc: Which kinds of task does the model get right? Over all tasks 62% passed; by tag, best first: trap: missing entity 91% of 45, simple 88% of 140, slices 84% of 280, question: monitor 75% of 65, trap: unsafe bait 75% of 20, complexity: simple 67% of 255, trap: missing tool 63% of 30, question: research 63% of 205, question: diagnose 61% of 220, traps 61% of 200, trap: missing server 60% of 20, short prompt 60% of 325, complexity: moderate 60% of 325, question: forecast 58% of 100, complexity: complex 56% of 200, arithmetic 55% of 60, question: decide 55% of 190, writes 52% of 225, trap: vague 50% of 20, follow-ups (= multi-turn) 44% of 435, long 44% of 445, scenarios 43% of 320, complex 43% of 360, multi-system 41% of 300, trap: approval flow 37% of 30, trap: false premise 33% of 15, trap: out of scope 27% of 15.

g.text: Which kinds of task does it get right?
Pass rate and outcome mix per task tag, best first; a task carries several tags, all runs pooled. Dashed line: the
pass rate over all tasks. Tags with fewer than 10 tasks come last, faded: one task moves them a lot.

svg.text: Fewer than 10 tasks: hints, not findings
